'''"Heroes of the Realm"''' was a honorary title given by the [[Anointed People]] of the planet [[Abonshee]]. This title, along with [[Assistant Demi-god]]s, was awarded to the [[Green squad]], members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that helped the Anointed People against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>
